title: Skills: teach the related-list entry title translation key objects.OBJECT._relatedLists.LIST.label (follow-up of #36528)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Follow-up owed by PR #36574 (card #36528), from its `Skills-docs:` line. Filed by the seat, not claimed. Parent: #36528.

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:skills`

## What changes after PR #36574

A record page's tab title declared on the parent by an object-form `relatedLists` entry (`{ list, label, columns }`) gets a translation key on the parent, keyed by the entry's literal `list`:

```
objects.OBJECT._relatedLists.LIST.label
```

Only an authored entry `label` is translated; precedence is unchanged (entry `label`, then the child lookup field's `relatedListTitle`, then the child's plural label). The lint extractor emits the key, and `translation-target-unknown` flags a key naming no labelled entry.

## Ask

Teach it where an AI writing metadata will look, once PR #36574 has merged:

1. `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`: the object translation group table gains the `_relatedLists.LIST.label` row (with its `relatedLists` alias), next to `_tabs`.
2. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`: the `relatedLists` entry and its `label` say the title is translated under that key, and that a bare entry (no `label`) has nothing to translate.

Add or extend an eval case where the skill's evals cover translation keys. Pay for any added bytes inside the same files (the skills ratchet is not raised).

## Blocked-by

Blocked-by: #36574 (unmerged PR)

## Re-check

`grep -n "_relatedLists" skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`: no hit means the follow-up is still owed.
